work_unit: Create a narrated final LicenceIQ assessment video

coordinator_work: Rewrote the narration to match the existing 313-second live browser recording.
Added a timestamped OpenAI TTS and local FFmpeg assembly script.
Generated 11 narrated scenes from the approved text only, keeping the video, fictional licence, and credentials local.
Re-encoded the source into a broadly compatible H.264/AAC MP4.
execution.recovery: The first external TTS request was blocked pending explicit user approval. A local Windows TTS fallback then proved unavailable because no installed voice could be selected. After the user explicitly approved the prepared narration payload, the timestamped OpenAI TTS pipeline completed.

passed: Python syntax check passed for the timestamped OpenAI narration pipeline.
Narration extraction found 11 continuous scenes spanning 0 to 313 seconds.
The final video fully decodes through local FFmpeg.
Final inspection reports 00:05:13.04, H.264 High video at 1600x900 and 25 FPS, and AAC-LC stereo audio at 48 kHz.
OpenCV decoded the first, middle, and final frames, and measured 7,826 frames over 313.04 seconds.

limitations: The voice-over is synthetic and should be described as AI-generated when appropriate.
Only the prepared narration text was sent to OpenAI TTS; no video, licence image, credentials, tokens, or database data left the local workspace.
